cases.title: Title duplicated with its own name: the check can't tell which to grade, so the mentor asks for a rename or undo and grades nothing

rubric.reason: In turn 2 the mentor says "I can't check your moves yet, because there are two layers called Title now and I can't tell which one you shaped" and asks the learner to rename the copy or undo the duplicate, then say done again. It gives no verdict on any pair and offers no fix of its own.

Every name and time comes from the snapshot or the learner's record: Title, its Position moves at 0.5–1.5, 1.5–3 and 3–4.37 s (rounded from 4.367), Scale 0.5–1.5 s, Old Take, CTRL, Icon, Logo's Rotation, Subtitle's Opacity, Bar's X Position and Glow's Blurriness. "Title copy" in turn 2 is only a suggested name, not a claim about an existing layer.

Turn 1 is the proposal with one short line per leave-out kind and ends on the land-hard question. Turn 2 is two sentences on the one duplicate problem and ends on the task to rename or undo and say done.
